facts.value: In the Bachelor of Arts program in art with a concentration in museum and curatorial practices, you’ll focus on international themes and issues at the forefront of contemporary museum and heritage studies. This prepares you to work in and lead museums and cultural institutions around the world. You will develop the ability to think critically and communicate by studying various ethical and institutional issues, such as decolonization and repatriation claims, activist curating and broadening museum audiences.
